injury_descriptions: The foot is not aligned with the body's momentum, creating lateral shearing forces on the ankle ligaments. | The foot is rolled sideways at the ankle (inversion/eversion), the classic lateral ankle-sprain mechanism. injury_preventions: Land with the foot pointing along the direction of movement and keep the knee centered over the foot. | Land with the foot flat and pointed along the direction of movement; strengthen the peroneal muscles and practice stable single-leg landings.
